## Design specs from Webflow source

### Banner strip
- `background-color: #082753`, full-width, `padding: 10px 5%`
- Centered flex row: rocket emoji + text + "Join Beta" underlined white link
- Font: 14px white

### Navbar
- White bg, `padding: 6px 1%`, sticky, `z-index: 999999`
- Three-column: logo (130px, image `Group-46895.svg`) | centered nav links | right CTAs + hamburger
- Nav links: `color: #082753`, 16px, weight 500
- **Solutions dropdown**: rich card with `border-radius: 12px`, shadow, 4 service rows with icons + descriptions + "Coming Soon" badges (blue `#1890ff` on `#e6f7ff`). Bottom CTA: `bg-[#21cfff12]`, `rounded-lg`
- **Resources dropdown**: simple card, `border: 1px solid #dde3e8`, `rounded-xl`, min-w 190px. Blog + Help Center links
- Login: outlined, `border: 1px solid #082753`, hover `bg-[#082753] text-white`, `rounded-[10px]`, `px-5 py-2`, 13px
- Schedule Demo: gradient `from-[#21cfff] to-[#019ae6]` with arrow icon, `rounded-xl`, `py-2 pl-4 pr-12`, 13px
- Mobile hamburger: 48×48px black, `rounded-[10px]`, 3 white lines

### Footer
- `bg-[#082753]`, `py-[72px] px-[5%] pb-4`, max-w 1280px
- Left: newsletter card with dark radial gradient bg, `border: 0.5px solid #05bafe61`, `rounded-[20px]`, `p-[30px]`. Sparkle icon, "Join 500+ Subscribers", gradient heading text, email form with button inside input wrapper
- Right: logo `f-new.svg` + social icons (38×38px, `bg-[#ffffff0d]`, `rounded-[10px]`, inline SVGs for LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook), then 4-col link grid
- Footer links: `color: #fffc` (white 80% opacity), hover `#fff`, 16px. Column titles: 18px bold white
- Copyright: centered pill `bg-[#113569]`, `rounded-[10px]`, `px-[15px] py-1`: "Designed with ❤️ from India" + flag

## Rules
- Use Tailwind classes matching exact Webflow values
- Images: `/images/webflow/FILENAME` 
- `"use client"` only where needed
- NO `any` types
- Use CSS `group`/`group-hover` for dropdown hover behavior
- Mobile nav uses Sheet component
- Keep nav data in constants file
- Add `description` field to NavItem type for Solutions dropdown

2. `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts` — add descriptions to Solutions children; add App Dev 4th item

## Key design decisions

### Banner
- `bg-[#082753]`, `py-[10px] px-[5%]`, full-width flex row centered
- Text: "🚀 We're upgrading..." 14px white + "Join Beta" underlined white link

### Navbar
- White bg, `py-[6px] px-[1%]`, sticky, `z-[999999]`
- Three-column layout: logo 130px | centered links | right CTAs + hamburger
- Logo: `<Image src="/images/webflow/Group-46895.svg" width={130} height={36} />`
- Nav links: color `#082753`, 16px, weight 500
- **Solutions dropdown**: `min-w-[410px]`, rounded-xl shadow card. 4 rows with inline SVG icons + title + description. Row 1 (Web Dev): has border-bottom. Rows 2-4: "Coming Soon" badge. Bottom CTA section with `bg-[#21cfff12] rounded-lg`.
- **Resources dropdown**: `min-w-[190px]`, simple card with border `border-[#dde3e8] rounded-xl p-2`. Blog + Help Center links.
- Login button: `border border-[#082753] text-[#082753] rounded-[10px] px-5 py-2 text-[13px] font-bold hover:bg-[#082753] hover:text-white`
- Schedule Demo button: gradient bg + SVG arrow icon at right, `rounded-xl py-2 pl-4 pr-12 text-[13px] font-bold`
- Hamburger: `w-12 h-12 bg-black rounded-[10px]`, 3 white lines

### Footer
- `bg-[#082753] py-[72px] px-[5%] pb-4`
- Grid: `.75fr 1.25fr` (newsletter card | right side)
- Newsletter card: dark radial gradient, `border-[0.5px] border-[#05bafe61] rounded-[20px] p-[30px]`

  - Privacy line with shield icon
- Right: logo `f-new.svg` + 3 social icons (`bg-[#ffffff0d] rounded-[10px] w-[38px] h-[38px]`) + 4-col link grid
- Footer links: `text-[#fffc]` hover `text-white`, 16px
- Column titles: 18px bold white
- Copyright: centered pill `bg-[#113569] rounded-[10px] px-[15px] py-1` with flag SVG

## Type change
```ts

  label: string;
  href: string;
  description?: string;  // NEW — for Solutions dropdown
  children?: NavItem[];
  external?: boolean;
  comingSoon?: boolean;
}
```

## Navigation constants changes
- Solutions children get `description` strings
- Add 4th child: App Development (comingSoon: true)
- Resources children: Blog + Help Center (external link)
- CTA: Login (external) + Schedule Demo

## No new dependencies needed — all inline SVGs from Webflow source

content.text:
Plan is solid. Here is the complete implementation I will write once you approve execution:

---

## What I read

**HTML source:** navbar has a banner strip, 3-column nav (logo | centered links | right CTAs), a rich Solutions dropdown card (4 services with inline SVGs + a bottom "Can't find what you're looking for?" CTA), a simple Resources dropdown (Blog + Help Center), Login outlined button, Schedule Demo gradient button, and a 48×48 black hamburger.

**CSS source:** confirmed all exact values — `#082753` navy, `#21cfff`→`#019ae6` gradient, `border-[#dde3e8]`, shadow values, footer `bg-[#082753]`, newsletter card dark radial gradient, social links `bg-[#ffffff0d]`, coming-soon badge colors `#1890ff / #e6f7ff`, copyright pill `bg-[#113569]`.

**Footer HTML:** 2-col grid (newsletter card left | right section), right section has logo + inline social SVGs + 4-column link grid (About, Services, Resources, Help), legal wrapper with pill containing "Designed with ❤️ from India" + Indian flag SVG.

---

## Files I will write

### 1. `src/types/navigation.ts`
Add `description?: string` field.

### 2. `src/lib/constants/navigation.ts`
- Solutions: 4 children with `description` strings (Web Development, UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, App Development)
- Resources: Blog + Help Center (`external: true`)
- CTA: Login (external to `https://portal.boldteq.com/`) + Schedule Demo

### 3. `src/components/layout/navbar.tsx`
Full rewrite — no `"use client"` needed at component level (hover via CSS `group`). Structure:
- `<header>` wrapping banner strip + sticky nav
- Banner: `bg-[#082753] py-[10px] px-[5%]` — flex centered — rocket text + "Join Beta" underline link
- Navbar: `bg-white py-[6px] px-[1%] sticky top-0 z-[999999]`
- Three columns: logo image | `nav-23-links` flex row | right CTAs
- `NavDropdownSolutions` — hover group, card `min-w-[410px]` with shadow, 4 rows (row 1 border-bottom, rows 2–4 disabled pointer-events), bottom mnav-inn CTA block
- `NavDropdownResources` — hover group, simple card `min-w-[190px] border border-[#dde3e8] rounded-xl p-2`
- Login: `border border-[#082753] text-[#082753] text-[13px] font-bold rounded-[10px] px-5 py-2 hover:bg-[#082753] hover:text-white`
- Schedule Demo: gradient with arrow SVG background-image pattern replicated as inline SVG in `<span>` at right edge
- Hamburger button: `w-12 h-12 bg-black rounded-[10px]` with 3 white line divs, `onClick → setMobileOpen(true)`
- `"use client"` only for the hamburger state

### 4. `src/components/layout/mobile-nav.tsx`
Full rewrite — Sheet from right, logo image `f-new.svg`, collapsible sections for Solutions (with coming-soon badges), flat links for How It Works / Pricing / Our Work / Our Mission, collapsible Resources, then Login + Schedule Demo CTAs.

### 5. `src/components/layout/footer.tsx`
Full rewrite — Server Component (no `"use client"`), newsletter form needs client state so extract `FooterNewsletter` as `"use client"` sub-component inline or import from shared. Structure:
- `bg-[#082753] py-[72px] px-[5%] pb-4`
- `max-w-[1280px] mx-auto`
- CSS grid `.75fr 1.25fr` gap `3rem`
- Newsletter card: radial gradient bg, border, rounded-[20px], p-[30px]
  - Sparkle pill + heading + description + email form (input with absolute button) + privacy line
- Right: logo + social icons row + 4-col links grid (border-top, pt-[2.8rem])
- Legal wrapper: centered flex, copyright pill `bg-[#113569] rounded-[10px] px-[15px] py-1`

---

## Key technical decisions

- All SVG icons from Solutions dropdown are **inline** (copied verbatim from Webflow HTML) — no file references needed since Next.js image optimization doesn't work for inline SVGs
- Schedule Demo button uses a `<span>` with the arrow SVG beside the text (instead of CSS background-image), keeping it pure Tailwind
- `group`/`group-hover` CSS for all dropdown hover states — no JS needed for desktop
- `"use client"` only on: hamburger toggle state in Navbar, newsletter form state in footer
- Images referenced as `/images/webflow/FILENAME` per spec
- No `any` types anywhere
- `NavItem.description` is optional — only Solutions children use it

Ready to execute. Shall I proceed?
